verdicts.reason: All rules hold: the only honest check is a person so checkKind is human-only, status is gated (not above the brief's Stop), the sheet keeps nulls as missing and ends at a STOP line, and checkRunnable is false.

All rules hold: a jq join with exit code 0 enforces the same N lines per candidate, null cells stay null, and no rank, total, or fluency field may exist; status is assisted as the brief rates it, and checkRunnable is honestly false.

All rules hold: a jq N/N count enforces one note per line, evidence as a quote resolved at its resume line or blank, and no overall or vibe field; blank passes, status is assisted, and checkRunnable is false.

All rules hold: jq schema validation enforces keys equal to the accepted scorecard fields, null blanks, and a quote that resolves at its resume line, and allows an all-null result; status is assisted, and checkRunnable is false.

All rules hold: a program checks each line's req quote at its line number (no quote fails, so no extra traits), the status stays awaiting manager accept, zero lines is a valid result, status is assisted, and checkRunnable is honestly false since no program exists.
